gen-gf-walter-turncoat-work-sans: Strokes like bent copper pipe give Walter Turncoat a loose, tubular charm, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Work Sans, a plain sans, keeps its letters tidy and open.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-bespoke-sans: Yomogi draws curves and straights at a single width, so its crescent-wrench c looks hand-inked and friendly. Bespoke Sans adds sharp, refined spacing.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-literata: Yomogi's rounded strokes look like cut lengths of cord. Literata, a text serif, brings a modest weight shift and wide, unclosed curves, so paragraphs would read smoothly and bookishly.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-bespoke-: Loose, hand-drawn and generous with side gaps, Yuji Hentaigana Akari stays clear even small. Bespoke Sans keeps curve ends well away from the stem, sharp and refined.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-bespok: Casual pen-and-paper letters with considerable room between neighbors set Yuji Hentaigana Akebono apart from its crisper partner. Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif, keeps long text sharp and uncluttered.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-litera: Literata is a serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones. Yuji Hentaigana Akebono, with its lettering-pen softness and low contrast, earns its place in big, short headings.
gen-gloria-hallelujah-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space at its curve ends. Gloria Hallelujah brings bent pipe-cleaner energy and comic looseness, while the sans-serif body does the careful, quiet work.
gen-nixie-one-gf-graduate: Graduate reads dignified and bookish, with generous white between letters and a low capital-to-lowercase step. Nixie One brings a nostalgic, retro-tech outline in its heading, while the serif handles the steady text.
gen-shadows-into-light-archivo: Archivo reads with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, editorial but approachable. Shadows Into Light is better at crowded, chalk-mark charm in a heading, while Archivo handles the plain sans-serif text.
gen-shadows-into-light-fs-epilogue: Wide-mouthed rounds and chalk-slate crowding make Shadows Into Light feel like casual pen-and-paper notes, friendly at a glance. Epilogue's wire-like monoline strokes glide along without any thick-and-thin drag.
